LightningComponentBundle.description: The Activity and Chatter panel from the right rail of the Lightning record page, redrawn for ARC: the New Event and Email composers, Timeline Settings, the Upcoming and Overdue timeline, and the record's Chatter feed with comments.

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: The object whose record page this sits on. Used to read the record id out of the route.

property.name: calendarUrl
property.label: View Calendar URL
property.description: Where the View Calendar action goes. ARC has no calendar of its own, so this opens in a new tab.
